proposals.before: On renzi Ma Yin of Jingjiang and Guizhou—acting Grand Preceptor, Secretariat director, and Prince of Fufeng—gained fief and enfeoffment; Ma Xizhen of Li-Lang—acting Grand Tutor and Palace Attendant—became acting Grand Guardian.
proposals.after: On renzi Ma Cong of Jingjiang and Guizhou—acting Grand Preceptor, Secretariat director, and Prince of Fufeng—gained fief and enfeoffment; Ma Xizhen of Li-Lang—acting Grand Tutor and Palace Attendant—became acting Grand Guardian.
proposals.reason: Chinese names 馬賨 (Ma Cong), not 馬殷 (Ma Yin); the idiomatic English wrongly reuses Ma Yin for a different person.

proposals.before: On renzi, Jingjiang army military commissioner, Guizhou circuit surveillance commissioner, acting Grand Preceptor, concurrent Secretariat Director, Prince of Fufeng Ma Yin gained added fief households and enfeoffment; Li-Lang surveillance commissioner, acting Grand Tutor, concurrent Palace Attendant Ma Xizhen was made acting Grand Guardian.
proposals.after: On renzi, Jingjiang army military commissioner, Guizhou circuit surveillance commissioner, acting Grand Preceptor, concurrent Secretariat Director, Prince of Fufeng Ma Cong gained added fief households and enfeoffment; Li-Lang surveillance commissioner, acting Grand Tutor, concurrent Palace Attendant Ma Xizhen was made acting Grand Guardian.
proposals.reason: Literal English also renders 馬賨 as Ma Yin; should be Ma Cong.

proposals.before: Mingzong had served under Jianfeng in Taiyuan's inner guard; now Jianfeng lay crippled by stroke, so Mingzong visited to comfort him.
proposals.after: Mingzong had been a personal guard commander in Taiyuan's inner barracks with Jianfeng as his deputy; now Jianfeng lay crippled by stroke, so Mingzong visited to comfort him.
proposals.reason: Chinese 帝嘗為太原內牙親將，建豐為副 makes Jianfeng the deputy under the Emperor, not the superior; idiomatic "served under Jianfeng" reverses the relationship.

proposals.before: On gengyin Li Yan of Guest Reception became Si defense commissioner and Li Ling of Heyang became crown prince mentor.
proposals.after: On gengyin Li Yan of Guest Reception became Si defense commissioner and Li Ling of Hezhong became crown prince mentor.
proposals.reason: 河中 is Hezhong (Hedong), not Heyang (河陽).

decisions.reason: Chinese names 馬賨, not 馬殷; idiomatic Ma Yin misidentifies the Prince of Fufeng. The proposed Ma Cong matches 馬賨 and leaves the rest of the sentence intact.
Same error in the literal field: the name is 馬賨 (Ma Cong), not Ma Yin. Replacing only that name corrects the mistranslation without other changes.
